summary: The test suite covers core requirements well: all three retention policies (max age, keep-latest-N, max total size), combined policies, dry-run mode, and GitHub Actions workflow structure/execution via act. However, critical gaps exist: (1) no tests for malformed JSON or invalid policy values in the CLI script — only the module is tested; (2) fixture files (case-max-age.json, etc.) are referenced in tests but not provided, making fixture correctness impossible to verify; (3) limited edge case coverage (artifact name special characters, time zones, negative sizes, exactly-zero policies); (4) only 3 act test cases for workflow execution. Unit tests are well-organized with good mocking and clear contexts, but workflow tests' hard-coded expected values and external fixture dependency create brittle assertions. The suite would catch basic regressions on the happy path but miss edge cases and robustness issues.
